about: Independent evaluation set for a clue-to-word (word-finding) aid for people with aphasia. Targets are the 175 test items of the Philadelphia Naming Test (PNT; Roach, Schwartz, Martin, Grewal & Brecher, 1996; Moss Rehabilitation Research Institute), in administration order (p001 = PNT item 1 ... p175 = PNT item 175); the 10 practice items are excluded. Each target has three written clue styles: 'plain' (a clear description in ordinary words, 5-12 words), 'broken' (how a person with anomic aphasia might type or say it: fragments, fillers, restarts, corrected wrong words, loose grammar, an occasional misspelling; 4-14 words) and 'sparse' (2-4 key words, no sentence). No clue contains its target, an accepted answer, a word built from them, or either half of a compound target. 'accept' lists the answers to count as correct (the target plus true synonyms or regional variants only); compare case-insensitively and treat simple singular/plural forms as equal. The clues were written without sight of the tool's prompts or code. Where a PNT name has more than one meaning (for example bat, nail, pipe, fan, top, seal, can, glass, iron, letter, ring, ruler, scale, well, football, vest, wagon) the clues describe one everyday sense chosen for this set; the pictured sense was not re-checked against the PNT picture file. Only the target words come from the PNT; the clues are original, and this file is not a clinical instrument.
source: Official alphabetised target list 'PNT Targets ABC order' (PDF, copyright 1996 AEHN / Moss Rehabilitation Research Institute): https://www.jefferson.edu/content/dam/academic/research/rehabilitation-research-institute/documents/pnt-targets-abc-order.pdf - linked from the MRRI Philadelphia Naming Test page https://rehabilitationresearch.jefferson.edu/innovations/philadelphia-naming-test.html (accessed 2026-11-12). 175 of 175 test items verified against that list, each with its administration position 1-175. The 10 practice items (A-J: peas, umbrella, waitress, tank, dress, hamburger, mirror, tiger, guitar, whale) are not included.
